mapper.select: SELECT p.*, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post_comments pc WHERE pc.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count FROM posts p ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
SELECT p.*, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post_comments pc WHERE pc.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count FROM posts p WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (title, category, summary, content, cover_title, cover_color, tags, views, likes, created_at) VALUES (#{post.title}, #{post.category}, #{post.summary}, #{post.content}, #{post.coverImage}, #{post.coverColor}, #{post.tags, typeHandler=com.example.demo.handler.StringToListTypeHandler}, #{post.views}, #{post.likes}, #{post.createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{post.title}, category = #{post.category}, summary = #{post.summary}, content = #{post.content}, cover_title = #{post.coverImage}, cover_color = #{post.coverColor}, tags = #{post.tags, typeHandler=com.example.demo.handler.StringToListTypeHandler} WHERE id = #{post.id}
UPDATE posts SET views = views + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
